decisions.reason: After several years and with a strong fit to the firm's established thermoforming workflows, management would likely judge this blank as near or above aspiration and use available slack to keep it unless a clearer shortfall appears.

Because the lacquer had weak initial prominence and no later website signal, management would see more uncertainty and some risk of results below aspiration, but its close fit with the firm's materials capabilities still makes retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

This spray supports the firm's digital and clinical workflow strategy, so unless its performance has clearly fallen short of comparable products, management would be inclined to keep it as a complementary offering.

A custom earmold line uses core hearing-care relationships, shared production know-how, and international channels, which would typically keep its performance at or above aspiration and favor continuation.

Hearing-protection earmolds are more niche and therefore more exposed to aspiration shortfalls, but their overlap with existing earmold capabilities means management would usually continue them while the contribution remains acceptable.
